about: Building data shipped with the app. Generated by scripts/import-foe-calc.mjs from foe-calc.com (texts licensed CC BY-SA 3.0; building data originates from the game Forge of Empires by InnoGames). Only buildings named in the inventory snapshot are included. Values merge into a device database without overwriting anything entered by hand.
